142542.overview:
Paying homage to the classic beat 'em up in the arcades, The Simpsons: Treehouse of Horror stars Homer, Bart, and Krusty as they try to stop an alien invasion from taking over the Earth. The game plays just like the original arcade version, featuring lots of characters and bosses -- including Futurama and Family Guy cameos -- as well as exciting levels, cool weapons, and vehicles to drive!

Includes Bonus Games!
 - Reclaim Burns Manor: Play as Vampire Mr. Burns and stop the criminals from looting your mansion
 - Tournament mode: Face enemies in one-on-one combat
 - Family Guy: You are Peter and see the events that unfold before he and his family are teleported to Springfield

142616.overview: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rescue-Palooza is a fan-made beat 'em up using OpenBOR and created as an update and homage to the classic NES titles. It includes 4-player local co-op with 60 playable characters, more than 20 stages and bonus levels, as well as rideable vehicles. It also features improved graphics, voice clips from the cartoon show and countless references to the toy line, comics and culture. Cowabunga!

186173.overview: A tribute to 90s arcade brawlers, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shell Shocked was created with the OpenBOR engine by White Dragon Software and released in 2014. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players, and choose from 11 characters to fight with, including the four ninja heroes and even villains like Bebop, Rocksteady and Foot Clan soldiers. There's nearly a dozen stages to fight through, with well-crafted cutscenes to advance the story. Overall, the game plays just like the 1989 arcade original, adding a few more special moves and upgrades for a great, new adventure.

200568.overview:
Red Sky Battle is an attempt by creators Pro Igork and ALEX_230_VOLT to extend and finish "Wrath of Shredder", a long abandoned TMNT fan project originally conceived by BonusJZ.

Per the creators:

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - Red Sky Battle is a Ninja Turtle fangame created by Pro Igrok and ALEX_230_VOLT based on BonusJZ's Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - The Wrath of Shredder using OpenBOR. Actually for now, this game is more like an extension of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - The Wrath of Shredder. The game features all 4 turtles playable + 3 secret characters (comparing to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - The Wrath of Shredder with only Leonardo and Donatello playable + 1 secret character), 22 levels (comparing to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - The Wrath of Shredder with only 6), 2 game modes, 4 player support and TMNT launcher - a special program to unlock extra features by entering codes, which can be found during gameplay.

The game is still in development and future version will be completely independent from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - The Wrath of Shredder with exclusive plot, enemies and combat system.

Sadly, this development appears halted as well, and like BonusJZ the status of Pro Igork and ALEX_230_VOLT are unknown. However, despite technically being an abandoned demo, Red Sky Battle is fully playable and features an impressive level of detail, polish, and techniques. It is well worth a play-through and makes a fine addition to any TMNT fan's collection.

453607.overview:
The year is 3022.
The United Planets Ship, the Avalon 1, is drifting through the outer reaches of the known universe.
Colonel Ardon C. Striker and his crew land on a planet and discover a device in an ancient outpost. When they activate it a wormhole opens, connecting the device with a distant planet: "Earth".
Several million years ago an ancient race of advanced humanoid beings created this device, capable of near-instantaneous transportation across the universe with a subspace wormhole. This device has been used by countless races since its creation.

Turrican, a mutant bio-engineered warrior, has the task of planetary reclamation, by eliminating the hostile machines TERMINATOR on planet Earth, and, finally, destroying SKYNET.

466582.overview:
TMNT Shredder’s Revenge OpenBOR is an adaptation of this popular Ninja Turtles beat'em up that uses the free OpenBOR engine. This version of the game allows you to relive the same story as in the original game, but with some minor changes. The most important thing, which is being able to control the Ninja Turtles as they take on hundreds of enemies belonging to the Foot Clan, is still there in all its glory.
Leonardo, Raphael, Michelangelo, and Donatello

As usual in any self-respecting Ninja Turtles game, in TMNT Shredder’s Revenge OpenBOR, you will be able to choose between any of its four main characters. In addition, if you have friends, you can play with up to four players locally, each controlling one of the turtles. Each character, of course, has its own special moves and attacks. In fact, you may even notice that some of the characters move faster, while others hit harder.
An Arcade Mode full of danger

The main game mode in TMNT Shredder’s Revenge OpenBOR is the Arcade Mode. In this mode, you will have to advance through each of the game's settings by defeating all the enemies that get in your way. Keep in mind that playing alone is much more complicated than playing with friends. If you're lucky enough to be able to play locally with friends, you will be able to fight much better against the Foot Clan's forces. The default difficulty level is also quite high.
